integrity: Exact symbolic residue-margin proof, explicit universal uniformization expansion, all-step pure-birth converse, and rational three-state phase diagram; independent mathematical validation has not been conducted.
limitations: Finite conservative CTMC generators and completed fifth-order Radau IIA steps only; the counterexample dimension may grow without bound near the threshold; no assertion for nonlinear SSP or nonnegative internal stages.
title: A sharp completed-step positivity ceiling for fifth-order Radau IIA on finite Markov generators
